settings.text: BW Lift & Tool is the equipment side of Big Wave Auto, an independent dealership in Sussex, Wisconsin. We recondition our own inventory on a lift in our bay, and we sell the equipment we'd buy again — through a distributor we've dealt with for years, at a cash price that's on the page, with the freight spelled out. Come see one run before you buy; showroom by appointment, Mon–Sat 9–6.
